verdict.rationale: First-party docs give a Docker-based setup for self-hosting either Unleash Open Source or Unleash Enterprise in your own environment, including cloning the repo and starting the server with Docker Compose. The open-source GitHub repo and a community recommendation of Unleash as a self-hosted LaunchDarkly alternative corroborate this. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence on production self-hosting (scaling, upgrades, database requirements) and hands-on reports of running it.
